a disabled (admin-locked) client frees a slot; re-enabling it when full is rejected
lifting the cap (limit raised by a developer step) allows another client

0006 on a 0005 database: recount excludes players, nothing else changes, still inactive
executing every 0005 statement a second and third time succeeds and changes nothing (idempotent)

rollback (drop triggers, tables, column) restores the pre-0005 shape without altering user data
